summary: Pre-alpha: Host supervisor with IPC v1 (identity-checked pipe, start on demand, idle exit) and one prototype pane per Host; no Terminals, GUI or recovery yet

commands.name: host.start
commands.summary: Start a detached per-user Host (one start lock per endpoint), optionally owning one prototype ConPTY pane

commands.name: host.status
commands.summary: Host and pane process ids, protocol, job breakaway, environment, idle grace and clients

commands.name: host.health
commands.summary: Heartbeat: verify the Host's identity, complete the handshake and measure the answer time

commands.name: host.attach
commands.summary: Prototype: interactive attach to the pane; Ctrl+B d or end of piped input detaches

commands.name: host.stop
commands.summary: Stop the Host; ending a live pane and every process in its job needs consent

commands.name: host.serve
commands.summary: Run the Host in this process (what host start launches detached)
